title: Feature Priming in Online Linear Regression: Sparse-Regret Lower Bounds and a Tight Univariate Rate
abstract: arXiv:2608.17573v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In high-dimensional online prediction, the best predictor may depend on only a few features, so regret should scale with sparsity rather than the ambient dimension. Feature priming pursues this goal by estimating feature weights from past data and refitting a minimum-norm predictor on the rescaled design. Warmuth and Amid asked at COLT 2023 whether any of three such rules admits a competitive online regret guarantee. Using the natural Moore--Penrose protocol based only on past data, we give a negative answer to the sparse-logarithmic form of this COLT open problem. Our analysis identifies a common obstruction: cheap nuisance interpolation causes the refit to underweight the truly predictive coordinate. An exact target-mass identity and a two-sign argument turn this effect into clipped prediction loss. translated_title: 在线线性回归中的特征启动：稀疏遗憾下界与紧致单变量速率
translated_abstract: 在高维在线预测中，最佳预测器可能仅依赖于少数几个特征，因此遗憾应随稀疏性而非环境维度扩展。特征启动通过从过去数据估计特征权重，并在重新缩放的设计上重新拟合最小范数预测器来实现这一目标。Warmuth和Amid在COLT 2023上询问，这三种规则中是否有任何一种能提供竞争性的在线遗憾保证。基于仅使用过去数据的自然Moore-Penrose协议，我们对这一COLT开放问题的稀疏对数形式给出了否定答案。我们的分析识别出一个共同障碍：廉价的干扰插值导致重新拟合低估了真正预测性坐标的权重。一个精确的目标质量恒等式和双符号论证将此效应转化为裁剪预测损失。Hadamard构造迫使所有三种规则对零损失单稀疏比较器产生$\Omega(\min\{T,\sqrt{d}\})$的遗憾，并附带扩展结果。
tldr: 本文证明在特征启动的在线线性回归中，三种规则均无法实现稀疏对数遗憾，并揭示了干扰插值导致的共同障碍，通过Hadamard构造给出下界。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that none of the three feature priming rules can achieve sparse-logarithmic regret in online linear regression, identifying nuisance interpolation as a common obstruction and establishing lower bounds via Hadamard constructions.
